_readme: The Stationer's case -- hand-authored v1, MEDIUM_SELECTION.md sec.2. Sibling to style_manifest.json (the technique-variant axis); cap fields (beat_signal, avoid_on, max_per_episode, min_spread_gap, status) are deliberately mirrored so pipeline/style_variety.lint() runs on this file unchanged inside pipeline/medium_variety.py. Unlike style_manifest.json there is no score generator yet -- when a medium bake-off produces real scores, migrate to a _build_manifest.py-style generator and stop hand-editing this file.

md_sketch.name: Sketchbook Ink
md_sketch.text_drift_note: already solved by SKILL.md sec.1's CRITICAL no-lettering clause; see the sl20 history in STYLE_SELECTION.md
md_sketch.motion_note: proven -- the whole current production pipeline runs on this medium
md_sketch.entry_framing: n/a -- this IS the baseline page, never proposed via the Stationer mechanism
md_sketch.right_tool_for: the default; everything human -- not proposed by medium_select.py, only ever the fallback

md_survey_plate.name: Survey Plate
md_survey_plate.text_drift_note: tick marks and measurements pull numerals; all real marks are deterministic overlay (/measuring-reed, /marginalia, path_draw), never baked
md_survey_plate.motion_note: no faces to animate; Seedance calm tier with named motions (water stirs, dust drifts, survey line draws on as $0 overlay); Kling only for a narration-mandated event beat; NEVER a bare pan-over-plate -- the Far Corner's $0-camera economics do NOT port, every survey spread still gets a real generative clip
md_survey_plate.entry_framing: tipped-in plate: cut-paper edges on the sketchbook ground, or full-bleed page-turn
md_survey_plate.right_tool_for: geography/scale/distance/architecture/measurement beats -- Bethesda's five porches, Jericho's compassed walls, the ark's cubits, a temple layout, a journey's spread; the 'one man alone in the far corner' isolation beat is its proven masterpiece shape
md_survey_plate.evidence: The Far Corner (whole short, user-approved: 'this is exactly what I wanted to build'); drawing_office/registry/cards/far_corner.json, the_sounding_line.json

md_archive.name: Archive Catalogue
md_archive.text_drift_note: catalogue register pulls labels + accession numbers; every glyph is deterministic overlay, never baked
md_archive.motion_note: lamplight breathing, dust motes, shadow sway (Seedance); static-hold temptation HIGH -- the motion-floor guardrail check exists for this card specifically
md_archive.entry_framing: tipped-in accession card under lamplight, cross-hatched linework
md_archive.right_tool_for: object-testimony beats -- the thirty pieces of silver as an accession item, the scarlet cord, the five smooth stones, a 'this thing remains as witness' beat; one object, catalogued, under lamplight
md_archive.evidence: The Closed File (stills-only POC, not yet in a finished moving episode); drawing_office/registry/cards/the_closed_file.json

md_ledger.name: Scribe's Ledger
md_ledger.text_drift_note: the highest-risk medium in the case -- an account book is a numerals magnet; the anchor's 'fine hand-ruled ink lines' are legal, digits are not; every glyph is overlay, never a generative writing hand (the never-animate-writing rule)
md_ledger.motion_note: the thinnest legal vocabulary -- lamplight breath, wet-ink sheen, paper cockle (generative), with strike-throughs as $0 overlays; expect this medium to lean hardest on the motion-floor check
md_ledger.right_tool_for: debt/count/record beats -- 'the wages of sin' as a ruled line, Zacchaeus' fourfold restitution, and the killer beat this medium exists for: the handwriting of ordinances (Col 2:14) BLOTTED OUT, a ledger line struck through via /bleeding-word or /keeper-hand overlay
md_ledger.evidence: The Double-Entry Page (stills-only POC, not yet in a finished moving episode); drawing_office/registry/cards/the_double_entry_page.json

md_scroll.name: Ancient Scroll
md_scroll.text_drift_note: CONFIRMED, not just estimated (EW01 pilot, 2026-08-11): wording the scene as 'papyrus columns suggesting ancient script' produced a page covered edge-to-edge in dense pseudo-handwriting -- not real words, but unmistakably 'a page full of writing,' the same GUARDRAIL violation. Fixed by rewording toward 'OVERWHELMINGLY BARE... NOT rows of writing... at most 3-4 isolated, sparse, disconnected ink marks.' Use that phrasing pattern, not 'suggesting script,' for every future Scroll render. Surface stays blank/ruled; Scribed Ink overlays any verse, arriving WHOLE if red-letter, per LAW 1
md_scroll.motion_note: the roll IS the motion, but a generative roll risks morphing -- use the multi-stage hard-cut pattern (roll states as separate stills, the CUT tells the unrolling) per SKILL.md sec.3's event-beat rule, never one clip asked to morph the unroll
md_scroll.right_tool_for: the-Word-itself beats -- the Isaiah scroll unrolled at Nazareth (Luke 4:17), Jehoiakim's penknife (Jer 36), Ezekiel eating the scroll, the sealed scroll of Revelation 5
md_scroll.evidence: The One-Take Scroll (stills-only POC); EW01 Two Goats pilot s12_scripture (first real production use, 2026-08-11 -- required one reword after the pseudo-script drift above; the fixed version reads clean, verified by eye); drawing_office/registry/cards/the_one_take_scroll.json

md_night_ink.name: Night Threshold
md_night_ink.text_drift_note: the friendliest of the inserts on text risk; the anchor already bans the glitter/lens/cinema vocabulary that caused drift in The Token
md_night_ink.motion_note: flame breathes, the pale wash reserve pulses evenly (never sparkles)
md_night_ink.status_note: Mini bake-off run 2026-08-11 (4 renders, jesus_ref + moses_ref x silhouette + close framings) -- identity-lock held cleanly on BOTH characters at BOTH framings. face_scale raised from 'silhouette-only' to 'readable' on that evidence. Then used for real in the EW01 Two Goats pilot (s01_hook, THIRD character -- Aaron -- never tested under this medium before): rendered clean on the first attempt, no reroll needed, identity confirmed by eye against Aaron's Sketchbook-medium appearances in the same episode. Status stays 'caution', not 'production_approved' -- strong evidence across 3 characters and 2 contexts now, but still no finished MOVING episode (only stills) and no full-episode bake-off rigor.
md_night_ink.right_tool_for: night/threshold/watch beats -- blood on the doorposts at midnight, 'the door was shut' (Matt 25:10), Rahab's window, the courtyard fire, Gethsemane's edge
md_night_ink.evidence: The Token (stills-only POC); poc_living_sketchbook/_style_identity_bakeoff/stills_night_threshold/ (cast mini bake-off, 2026-08-11); EW01 Two Goats pilot s01_hook (first real production use, Aaron, clean on first render); drawing_office/registry/cards/the_token.json
